items.q: How much of $1,000 in an S&P fund sits in 10 companies?

items.q: Why keep cash or Treasuries on hand?
items.a: So you're **never a forced seller** and can keep **buying the dip**.

items.q: What's the best hedge when hiring slows?
items.a: A **steady income**: keep your job and keep investing.
